correctness.rationale: The squared norm for an ordered pair of independent updates gives P_i P_j P_i, before taking the top eigenvalue on the zero-sum subspace. The linear vector (-3,-1,1,3) gives the one-step weighted Laplacian gap bound 1/5, achieved at (3/10,2/5,3/10); attainment fixes both outer probabilities by the end-vertex eigenvector equations. For the second step, reflection averaging adds d^2(P1-P3)^2 to the symmetric moment because the outer projections commute. The odd-block top eigenvector has positive unequal coordinates for interior a, making this increment strictly positive on the maximizing direction when d is nonzero. The symmetric even block is dominated there, and either boundary value of a leaves the path disconnected. The top odd-block eigenvalue is the displayed f: the norm term has second derivative at least -2 and the trace second derivative is 5, giving f'' >= 3/2. The analytic derivative has opposite endpoint signs and is negative at 3/10. On P3, the two rank-one projected lines in the zero-sum plane have squared inner product 1/4, yielding the stated trace and determinant and a strictly decreasing factor in p(1-p). P2 has only one choice. The decimals and two-step objective separation reproduce independently.
residual_risks: Only a fixed iid law and an adversarial deterministic start are classified; the replay tests do not independently prove global optimization without the analytic argument.
